concerns.text: T003 extracts commit‑doc pairs by cloning the target repositories without fixing them to a specific commit or tag. This makes the data source mutable across runs, violating Constitution I (Reproducibility) which requires deterministic, immutable inputs for reproducibility.

No task invokes the Reference‑Validator Agent to verify external citations, breaching Constitution II (Verified Accuracy). The plan/spec contain citations that must be validated before any review points are awarded.
